Pharmacopoeias. In Eur. (see p.vii). Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Birch Leaf). The whole or fragmented dried leaves of Betula pendula and/or B. pubescens as well as hybrids of both species. It contains not less than 1.5% of flavonoids, calculated as hyperoside (C21H20O12 = 464.4), with reference to the dried drug. Protect from light. Profile Birch leaf is used in herbal medicine, particularly for urinary- tract disorders. Birch leaf oil has also been used.
